name: Easy Tex-Mex Meatball, Potato, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Sheet Pan Bake

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes lengthwise, then cut each half into ½-inch thick wedges. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.

Trim and large dice zucchini. Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Divide both between the baking sheets with the potatoes. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 (1 oz) pkg taco seasoning
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide meatballs between baking sheets, nestling them into the veggies. Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and meatballs are warmed through, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (24 oz) pkg frozen turkey meatballs, fully cooked

instructions.primary_message: Right before serving, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
To serve, divide veggies and meatballs between plates or bowls. Top with sour cream, salsa, and green onions. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups sour cream
1 ½ cups salsa
